summaryZh: Lukas Chavez Lab 的具名研究新闻聚焦儿童癌症中的染色体外DNA（ecDNA），包括儿童癌症患者来源异种移植模型的验证，以及肿瘤异质性和治疗适应相关问题。该概述限于已捕获的带日期研究新闻。
researchQuestions: 如何验证儿童癌症患者来源异种移植模型用于ecDNA研究的适用性？
ecDNA相关肿瘤异质性如何与治疗适应相关？
topics: 肿瘤异质性与治疗适应
methods: 患者来源异种移植（PDX）模型研究与验证

evidence.quote: Publication of our comprehensive study validating patient-derived xenograft (PDX) models for ecDNA research in pediatric cancer now available!
This study finds that ecDNA-driven oncogene dosage heterogeneity promotes rapid adaptation to therapy in MYCN-amplified cancers.
Affiliate Faculty Lukas Chavez, PhD Associate Adjunct Professor, NS Chavez Lab
Lukas Chavez, PhD, Associate Professor in Sanford Burnham Prebys’ NCI-designated Cancer Center
